channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Alpaca Festival 2027: Open Call for Pattern-Based Performances, Workshops and Talks (Sheffield, UK)
item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

item.title: Shape Arts: Emergent Residency 2026/27 (Tate St Ives / Porthmeor Studios)
item.description: Shape Arts, with Tate St Ives · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 3,000 bursary for the selected residency artist (restricted to artists living or working in Cornwall, Devon or Somerset). Disabled artists in the rest of the UK can join the shortlisted cohort, which brings mentoring and profile but no stated bursary. No application fee.

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: Arts Council England: National Lottery Project Grants (rolling)
item.description: Arts Council England · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 1,000 to GBP 100,000 per project. Decisions in about 8 weeks for requests up to GBP 30,000, about 12 weeks above that. No application fee.

item.title: Creative Scotland: Open Fund for Individuals (rolling)
item.description: Creative Scotland · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 500 to GBP 50,000 (two levels: up to GBP 20,000 with decisions in 10 weeks, GBP 20,001 to 50,000 in 14 weeks). National Lottery funded. No application fee.

item.title: The Elephant Trust: Autumn 2026 Grant Round (UK)
item.description: The Elephant Trust · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · Grants to visual artists of up to GBP 5,000; typical awards range GBP 2,000 to GBP 5,000. Projects with a total budget exceeding GBP 30,000 are not supported. No application fee.

item.title: Fluxus-CPGA Prize at Frieze London 2026
item.description: Fluxus Art Projects, with the Comite Professionnel des Galeries d'Art and Frieze London · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 prize, shared between the artist and their gallery. Participation is free of charge.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.
